metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how quickly relieve neck tightness, stiffness, and pain in the comfort of your own home. 

We're going to break the video up into two parts. In the first part, we're going to do stretching exercises to get quick pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS. In the second, we'll focus on long-lasting relief with strengthening exercises. 

To get the best results, go through both parts (and exercises) and use what gives you the most relief. 

Watch now and get rid of neck pain for good!

Link to pull-up band: https://amzn.to/3PqXFe5

0:00 Intro
